positions.name: PlanningCallSettledItems
positions.frame: What did the 2026-10-01 planning call settle on archive retention, diagnostic sequencing, and grafting timing?
positions.why: Odette and Linus each state a concrete arrangement (Quillmoor retention, the Thistlewick diagnostic order and length, orchard grafting timing). Linus then ratifies all three with 'Agreed on all three.' The three subjects differ, but the ratifying act binds them into one decision set. The dimensional reads agree: the three assertions are plain claims, and the ratification is decision-grade. Without src-4 they would be separate claims, and src-4 has no content of its own.
